name: Exp_Fractal_MFI
summary: This EA trades based on the convergence of Fractal breakout signals and Market Facilitation Index (MFI) momentum readings. It enters long when a fractal breakout upward coincides with rising MFI indicating increasing market participation, and enters short on the inverse condition. Exits are triggered by opposing fractal signals or MFI divergence.
summary_zh: 该EA基于分形突破信号与市场促进指数(MFI)动量读数的共振进行交易。当向上分形突破与MFI上升（表明市场参与度增加）同时出现时做多，反向条件出现时做空。出场由反向分形信号或MFI背离触发。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用威廉姆斯分形（Fractal）与市场促进指数（MFI）的共振来捕捉趋势启动点。入场条件方面，做多需要价格突破上方分形且MFI值上升（代表成交量增加、市场效率提升），做空则需要价格跌破下方分形且MFI值上升。出场条件包括遇到反向分形信号、MFI出现背离（价格创新高但MFI下降或价格创新低但MFI上升），或触及止损/止盈。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，提供止损和止盈参数设置，但具体是否对每笔交易都严格设置止损取决于参数配置。整体来看，该策略属于威廉姆斯混沌交易体系的简化应用，适合趋势明确的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA leverages the confluence of Williams Fractals and Market Facilitation Index (MFI) to capture trend initiation points. For entry conditions, a long position requires price breaking above an upper fractal while MFI is rising (indicating increasing volume and market efficiency), and a short position requires price breaking below a lower fractal with rising MFI. Exit conditions include encountering an opposing fractal signal, MFI divergence (price making new highs while MFI declines or vice versa), or hitting stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a dynamic calculation based on account balance and risk parameters. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit configuration, though whether every trade strictly enforces stops depends on parameter settings. Overall, this strategy is a simplified application of Bill Williams' chaos trading framework, best suited for trending market environments.

pros: 双指标共振过滤假信号，提高入场准确性
基于威廉姆斯混沌理论，策略逻辑有理论依据
MFI能有效识别市场参与度变化，避免在低流动性时入场
分形突破自带趋势确认属性，减少逆势交易风险
pros_en: Dual-indicator confluence filters out false signals and improves entry accuracy
Strategy is grounded in Bill Williams' chaos theory with solid theoretical backing
MFI effectively identifies changes in market participation, avoiding low-liquidity entries
Fractal breakouts inherently confirm trend direction, reducing counter-trend trade risk
cons: 分形信号具有滞后性，突破信号出现时趋势可能已走了一段
震荡市中分形频繁出现，容易产生大量假突破导致连续亏损
缺乏对市场整体趋势环境的判断，可能在逆大势中频繁交易
固定止损止盈未考虑ATR等波动性指标，在不同市场条件下适应性差
cons_en: Fractal signals are inherently lagging; by the time a breakout is confirmed, a significant portion of the move may already be over
In ranging markets fractals appear frequently, generating numerous false breakouts and consecutive losses
Lacks assessment of overall market trend context, potentially trading against the higher-timeframe trend
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for ATR or volatility, leading to poor adaptation across varying market conditions
improvements: 增加多时间周期趋势过滤，例如在H4趋势方向确认后才在H1上交易分形突破
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，使风险管理适应市场波动性变化
增加震荡/趋势市场识别模块，在震荡市中暂停交易或切换为均值回归策略
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filtering, e.g., only trading fractal breakouts on H1 when H4 trend direction aligns
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt risk management to current market volatility
Add a ranging/trending market identification module to pause trading or switch to mean-reversion logic in choppy conditions

risk_points: 分形信号的滞后性可能导致在趋势末期入场，止损被触发概率较高
震荡市中假突破频繁，若无趋势过滤可能导致连续亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过大、高波动时止损过小
risk_points_en: Lagging nature of fractal signals may cause entries near trend exhaustion, increasing stop-loss hit probability
Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets without trend filtering can lead to consecutive losses
Fixed stops do not account for volatility — stops may be too wide in low-volatility and too tight in high-volatility environments
